[NCBK.4.3] Representative log events:

| Source | Category | Level | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| engine | `wm`     | DEBUG   | a fact arrived for a schema not in the registry; fact ignored |
| engine | `wm`     | WARNING | slot-conversion failure during the assert path |
| rule author | (any) | (any) | a `log` action from a rule's RHS |
